## Findings

- none

## Review

Base is `main`; merge base `5abb1eab02a9a5d6a83f69fe2b1556db7b335c22`. The worktree HEAD equals the published head `5865b019`, and I reviewed that sha.

Statement integrity. I read every hunk of the main-relative diff in full. No `theorem`/`def` signature changes: in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/LineMeasurement/Expanded.lean` only the proof of the private `heteroKron_sum_sum` changes, in `.../Projector.lean` only the proof of `sum_stateQForm_eprState_tauLineProj_one`, and in `.../SquareRootError.lean` and `.../LinePointOverlap.lean` only documentation. Reuse over duplication. The removed paragraphs only carried relocation history, whose removal CONTRIBUTING section 5 item 3 asks for, and the migration is recorded in `audits/2026-09-07-expanded-line-recovery.md` as that item requires.

Prose. The blueprint edit at `ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1819-1820` adds "applied to the addition postprocessing of Definition~\ref{def:line-tau-product-measurement}" to the data-processing step of `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`.
